main_text.p: scere, Jobi 22.22. Docere, Deut.6.7. in Jon. Pahel גִּמַּר Idem. Ithpah. אִתְגַּמַּר Perfici, perfectum fieri vel reddi, consummari: Consumi, absumi, perdi, destrui: Item Suffumigari, ut Cantic.3.6. Psal.45.9.

גְּמִירָא Ch.&Syr. Perfectus, absolutus, consummatus adjectivè; Perfectum, Consummatum, Totum, Integrum: & substantivè Absolutio, perfectio, consummatio: Consumptio, destructio, perditio; & adverbialiter Absolutè, integrè, penitus, prorsus, perfectè, In universum, totaliter, universaliter: ut Jesa.2.18. Sic עַד גְּמִירָא Psal.119.33. Item Holocaustum, Hebr. כָּלִיל, sacrificium Totum igne consumendum, ut Deut.33.10. Item Hyacinthinum, juxta quosdam, Ezech.23.6. Plur. גְּמִירִין, גְּמִירִי Perfecti, Absoluti.
Syr. Perfectio, Consummatio, 1. ad Corinth.13.10. ad Hebr.6.1.
Syr. Idem, ad Eph.4.12. adverbialiter; Prorsus, omninò, penitus, Lucæ 13.11. Act.4.18.
Syr. Perfectè, absolute, prorsus, penitus, Act.22.3. 1.ad Thess.5.23. & 1.Pet.1.3.
גְּמַר Ch. Carbunculus, lapis pretiosus, Jesa.54.12. Item Perfectio, absolutio, Ezech.27.24. & 23.12.
גּוּמְרָא Ch. Carbo, pruna, Exo.27.5. in Jon. Plur. גּוּמְרִין, גּוּמְרִי
